build_metalwoz_dataset: build the metalwoz dataset by calling the build function with opt to download and prepare dialogue data
load_metalwoz_data: load metalwoz dialogue data from JSONL files and merge with tasks table using load_data method
setup_system_teacher: setup the SystemTeacher to yield bot dialogue turns with prompts and labels for training a dialogue system
setup_user_simulator: setup the UserSimulatorTeacher to yield user dialogue turns with role-prefixed prompts for training a user simulator
filter_metalwoz_domains: filter metalwoz dialogue data to a subset of domains using the metalwoz_domains command line argument
